dinners.name: Rory's Mild Apple-Ginger Braised Chuck Roast
dinners.desc: The household favorite, Rory's original method: no sear, miso + tomato paste, gelatin in the broth, 325°F covered 4 hours, shredded into its juices. Served with bone broth rice and honey-ginger glazed carrots. Makes Chloe's Monday lunch and Wednesday's roast-beef rice bowls.

recipe.serves: 3 tonight (cooked beef: Rory 170 g · Wendy 140 · Chloe 70) + 360 g for Wed bowls + 70 g for Chloe's Mon lunch
recipe.time: 15 min prep · 4 hr covered at 325°F · in the oven by 12:45 PM · dinner ~5:15
ingredients: 3 lb (1.36 kg) grass-fed chuck roast (fridge, from Saturday's delivery)
1 apple, grated (~180 g)
1 medium yellow onion, diced (~150 g)
4 garlic cloves, minced
10 g fresh ginger, grated (1-in piece)
42 g (2 Tbsp) honey
30 g (2 Tbsp) apple cider vinegar
120 g (½ cup) low-sodium tamari
480 g (2 cups) organic bone broth, the only other liquid. Bloom 10 g (1½ Tbsp) gelatin in 60 g of this measured broth.
14 g (1 Tbsp) toasted sesame oil
16 g (1 Tbsp) tomato paste + 6 g (1 tsp) white miso whisked into a little of the broth
1¼ tsp kosher salt, ¾ tsp pepper. No oil, no sear.
Optional: 1 cinnamon stick + 1 star anise for the first 3 hours; sliced green onion + sesame seeds to finish
340 g bone broth rice (from today's batch): Rory 120 · Wendy 120 · Chloe 100
steps: 12:15 PM: oven to 325°F, rack low enough for the covered ceramic pot (5–6 qt Dutch oven works too).
Pat the roast dry, season all sides with salt and pepper. No sear: straight into the pot.
Add the apple, onion, garlic, ginger, honey, vinegar, tamari, broth with the bloomed gelatin, sesame oil, tomato paste and miso. Turn the roast to coat. Add cinnamon/star anise if using.
By 12:45: lid on tight, braise 4 hours undisturbed. Pull the cinnamon/star anise at 3:45.
4:45: done when it shreds easily with two forks (~200–205°F inside). If it resists, 20–30 min more.
4:50: shred in the pot and toss through the juices. If the sauce is thin, simmer uncovered on the stove 5–8 min to reduce.
Before plating, pack: Wed container 360 g beef + ½ cup juices (fridge, eat by Wed) and Chloe's Mon container 70 g beef + 1 Tbsp juices + 100 g rice (fridge).
Rory: 170 g beef with juices, 120 g rice, 150 g carrots ≈ 585 cal / 52 g P.
recipe.scale: His original is written for a 3–4 lb roast, so 3 lb is 1× with the original liquid amounts.
recipe.leftovers: 360 g beef → Wed bowls (fridge). 70 g → Chloe's Mon lunch (fridge). Nothing else planned.

sideRecipes.title: Honey-ginger broth-glazed carrots
sideRecipes.serves: ~420 g cooked (Rory 150 · Wendy 120 · Chloe 60; rest for snacks)
ingredients: 500 g organic carrots (from the 2 lb bag), peeled, cut in ¼-in coins
100 g bone broth
8 g honey
5 g fresh ginger, grated
¼ tsp kosher salt, squeeze of lemon
steps: 10-in skillet with a lid: carrots + broth + ginger, covered over medium-high 7–8 min until just tender.
Uncover, add the honey and salt, cook 3–4 min more, tossing, until the liquid is a glaze. Lemon to finish.

sideRecipes.title: Lemon-oregano chicken breasts (Sunday: 9 lunches + Tue car dinner)
sideRecipes.serves: 6 lb raw → ~2,020 g cooked: Rory 5 × 200 g · Wendy 4 × 150 g · Tue 370 g (Rory 160 · Wendy 150 · Chloe 60) · ~50 g spare
sideRecipes.time: 15 min + ~80 min air fryer (4 batches, mostly hands-off)
ingredients: 6 lb (2.72 kg) organic AIR-CHILLED boneless skinless chicken breasts, thick ends pounded to ¾ in
Zest of 2 lemons + 60 g lemon juice
4 g (2 tsp) dried oregano, 8 g (1 Tbsp) garlic powder, 4 g (2 tsp) smoked paprika
18 g (1 Tbsp) kosher salt, 1 tsp pepper, avocado-oil spray
steps: Toss the chicken with the lemon, spices and salt in a big bowl; spray lightly.
Air-fry about 1½ lb per batch at 380°F 16–18 min (single layer, don't stack), flipping halfway, to 165°F. Batches at ~1:00, 1:20, 1:40, 2:00.
Rest 5 min, slice, and weigh into the containers in the 2:25 step.

sideRecipes.title: 'Fire' lunch boxes: Rory ×5 (Mon–Fri) + Wendy ×4 (Mon–Thu), peas and carrots, aji verde
sideRecipes.serves: 9 lunches + Wendy's Tue bowl + Chloe's Tue fried rice
ingredients: Chicken from above: Rory 5 × 200 g, Wendy 4 × 150 g
Bone broth rice (today's batch): 9 × 120 g = 1,080 g

Peas and carrots (~1,300 g cooked): 3 × 16 oz bags organic frozen peas and carrots, 90 g bone broth, ¾ tsp salt, 1½ tsp honey, juice of ½ lemon. Rory 150 g per box, Wendy 100 g per box, + 100 g Wendy Tue, + 40 g Chloe Tue.
Aji verde, Sunday batch (~305 g, for Mon–Wed): 220 g Maple Hill Greek yogurt, 40 g cilantro (stems ok), 20 g grated parmesan, 20 g lime juice, 1 large garlic clove, 4 g salt. Blend smooth.

Aji verde, Wed-night mini batch (~118 g, for Thu–Fri): 85 g Maple Hill, 15 g cilantro, 8 g parmesan, 8 g lime juice, ½ garlic clove, 1.5 g salt. Rory's heat: blend a little jalapeño or hot sauce into his cups only.
steps: Peas and carrots in 2 batches: 12-in pan, covered, with 45 g broth each, medium heat 6–7 min until hot; season with salt, honey and lemon. Spread on a plate to cool 10 min.
Blend the Sunday aji verde 30 s. Portion 6 lidded steel cups × 40 g (Rory + Wendy Mon–Wed) and a Tue jar of 70 g (Rory 30 · Wendy 40). Fridge.
Rory's boxes (×5): 200 g chicken + 120 g rice + 150 g peas and carrots. Wendy's boxes (×4): 150 g chicken + 120 g rice + 100 g peas and carrots.
FRIDGE: Rory Mon/Tue/Wed + Wendy Mon/Tue/Wed. FREEZER: Rory Thu + Fri, Wendy Thu (move to the fridge the night before).
Reheat: lid cracked, microwave 2½–3 min (from fridge) to 165°F, stirring once; add the aji verde cold after.
Rory's box ≈ 623 cal · 77 g P · 52 g C · 10 g F with 40 g aji verde. Wendy's ≈ 497 cal · 61 g P.

sideRecipes.title: Chloe's Thursday jar: frozen mini meatballs + orzo (Sunday, 12 min, frozen)
ingredients: 5 frozen mini grass-fed beef meatballs (from the Oct 25 batch; ~17 left in the freezer)
45 g dry orzo (on hand) → ~100 g cooked
¼ cup (60 g) mild organic marinara (on hand), 1 tsp grated parmesan
steps: Cook the orzo 8–9 min in salted water; drain and cool.
Container: 5 meatballs + 100 g orzo + 60 g marinara. FREEZER (Thu is frozen-on-Sunday). Move to the fridge Wed night.
Thu morning: heat covered in a small saucepan with 1 Tbsp water 6–8 min, stirring, to 165°F. Pack hot in the preheated jar, parmesan on top.

dinners.name: Chermoula wild salmon + lemon-garlic asparagus
dinners.desc: Wild sockeye brushed with a mild herb-lemon-cumin chermoula (made Sunday) and roasted at 425°F, with Sunday's bone broth rice and lemon-garlic roasted asparagus. Red pepper flakes or Aleppo stirred into Rory's chermoula only.

ingredients: 1.25 lb (567 g) wild-caught sockeye, cut in 3 portions (frozen on delivery; fridge Sunday morning)

Chermoula (~100 g, made Sunday, fridge): 20 g cilantro + 15 g parsley chopped fine, 1 garlic clove grated, 3 g (1 tsp) cumin, 2 g (1 tsp) smoked paprika, zest of ½ lemon + 20 g lemon juice, 14 g (1 Tbsp) extra-virgin olive oil, 15 g water, 2 g salt. Half brushes the fish; half is the table sauce (Rory 15 g).

Lemon-garlic asparagus (~330 g cooked; Rory 150 · Wendy 120 · Chloe 50): 1.5 lb asparagus (2 bunches, use most), woody ends snapped; spray, ½ tsp salt, 1 garlic clove grated, zest of ½ lemon + squeeze
330 g bone broth rice (fridge, Sunday): Rory 120 · Wendy 110 · Chloe 100, + 2 Tbsp broth
Rory only: Aleppo or red pepper flakes in his chermoula
steps: 5:00: oven to 425°F, racks upper-middle and lower-middle; 2 parchment-lined half-sheet pans.
Asparagus on pan B with spray, salt and garlic; in at 5:05 on the lower rack, 12–14 min, shaking once. Zest and lemon after.
Pat the salmon dry, skin-side down on sprayed pan A, salt lightly, brush with half the chermoula.
5:10: salmon on the upper rack 10–12 min until the thickest part is 145°F and flakes. Pull Chloe's piece 2 min early.
Rice: covered with 2 Tbsp broth, microwave 2–3 min to steaming.
Rory: 190 g cooked salmon, 15 g chermoula, 120 g rice, 150 g asparagus ≈ 569 cal / 59 g P.

dinners.name: Car dinner after dance (Rory + Chloe) · Wendy's 'fire' bowl at home
dinners.desc: Lemon-oregano chicken wraps on Hero tortillas with hummus and aji verde, plus cucumber and pepper spears, eaten in the car. Wendy gets the 'fire' bowl at home. Dessert in the car: a small cup of Maple Hill with honey, since the Creami doesn't travel.
dinners.side: Cucumber + red bell pepper spears (+ apple slices for Chloe)

recipe.serves: 3: Rory + Chloe in the car, Wendy at home
recipe.time: 15 min before you leave for dance
ingredients: 370 g lemon-oregano chicken, sliced (fridge, Sunday): Rory 160 g, Wendy 150 g, Chloe 60 g
3 Hero flour tortillas (44 g each): 2 Rory, 1 Chloe
Cedar's organic hummus: 30 g Rory, 15 g Chloe
Aji verde (Sunday Tue jar): 30 g Rory, 40 g Wendy; none for Chloe
Spears: 1 English cucumber + 1 red bell pepper in sticks (~350 g; Rory 150 g, Chloe 100 g, a few into the wraps); 1 small apple sliced for Chloe
Wendy's bowl: 150 g chicken + 120 g bone broth rice + 100 g peas and carrots (all from Sunday) + 40 g aji verde + lemon wedge
Car dessert: 100 g Maple Hill + 10 g honey in a small lidded steel cup (Rory; Chloe gets a smaller one if she wants)
Packing: parchment, foil, insulated bag with an ice pack for the yogurt, napkins; Rory's hot sauce packet
steps: Warm Rory's and Chloe's chicken in a stainless skillet with 1 Tbsp broth 3–4 min to 165°F.
Warm the tortillas 15–20 s per side in a dry skillet. Spread hummus, add chicken, a few cucumber sticks and Rory's aji verde. Fold the sides and roll tight.
Toast seam-side down 1–2 min per side until sealed. Wrap in parchment, then foil. Eat within 2 hours.
Wendy: microwave her chicken + rice + peas and carrots covered 2–2½ min to 165°F; add the aji verde and lemon.
Rory: 2 wraps (88 g tortillas, 160 g chicken, 30 g hummus, 30 g aji verde) + 150 g spears ≈ 545 cal / 70 g P.

dinners.name: Apple-ginger beef rice bowls with a fried egg
dinners.desc: Sunday's shredded chuck re-crisped in a hot skillet with its juices, over bone broth rice, a fried OrgaNICK egg on top (house favorite), and smashed cucumber salad. 20 minutes, all from the fridge. Chili crisp on the side for Rory.
dinners.side: Smashed cucumber salad (coconut aminos, lime, garlic, sesame seeds)

ingredients: 360 g shredded apple-ginger chuck + ½ cup juices (fridge, from Sunday)
330 g bone broth rice (fridge, Sunday): Rory 120 · Wendy 110 · Chloe 100, + 2 Tbsp broth
3 OrgaNICK Corn & Soy Feed Free eggs, avocado-oil spray, pinch of salt

Smashed cucumber salad (~280 g; Rory 120 · Wendy 100 · Chloe 50 plain): 1 English cucumber smashed and cut in 1-in pieces, salted ½ tsp 10 min and drained; 10 g coconut aminos, 10 g lime juice, 3 g honey, 1 small garlic clove grated, 2 g toasted sesame seeds
2 green onions sliced, sesame seeds to finish; Rory only: chili crisp
steps: 5:00: smash, salt and drain the cucumber; set Chloe's plain pieces aside; dress the rest.
5:10: 12-in stainless skillet over medium-high, spray. Beef in an even layer with half the juices; leave it 3–4 min until the edges crisp, toss, add the rest of the juices; 2 min more to 165°F.
Rice: covered with 2 Tbsp broth, microwave 2–3 min to steaming.
5:18: wipe the pan, spray, fry the eggs over medium 2–3 min (lid on 30 s for set whites, runny yolk).
Bowls: rice, beef, egg, green onion, sesame; cucumbers on the side.
Rory: 150 g beef, 120 g rice, 1 egg, 120 g cucumbers ≈ 584 cal / 53 g P.
Tonight: blend the Thu–Fri aji verde mini batch; move Rory's Thu box, Wendy's Thu box, Thu rice and Chloe's Thu jar to the fridge.

dinners.name: Honey cashew chicken (air-chilled thighs) with broccoli + snap peas
dinners.desc: Rory's healthy cashew chicken: air-chilled thighs seared hard, glossy tamari-honey-ginger glaze reduced from bone broth (1 tsp sesame oil, no deep-fry, no cornstarch), broth-steamed broccoli and snap peas, toasted cashews on top, over bone broth rice. Mild; chili crisp on the side for Rory. Makes Wendy's Friday lunch.
dinners.side: Broth-steamed broccoli + sugar snap peas (in the dish)

recipe.serves: 3 + Wendy's Fri lunch (cooked chicken: Rory 180 g · Wendy 140 · Chloe 70 · Wendy Fri 150)
ingredients: 1.75 lb (795 g) organic AIR-CHILLED boneless skinless chicken thighs, trimmed, in 1-in pieces (frozen on delivery; fridge Tue night)
½ tsp kosher salt + 1 Tbsp (15 g) tamari to toss
Glaze: 150 g bone broth, 40 g low-sodium tamari, 25 g honey, 3 garlic cloves grated, 10 g fresh ginger grated, 10 g lime juice, 5 g (1 tsp) toasted sesame oil
Veg: 1 lb broccoli crowns in florets (~400 g) + 8 oz sugar snap peas, strings pulled; 100 g bone broth, pinch of salt
40 g organic dry-roasted unsalted cashews (Rory 10 · Wendy 10 · Chloe 8 · Wendy Fri 8)
380 g bone broth rice (frozen Sunday; fridge Wed night): Rory 90 · Wendy 90 · Chloe 80 · Wendy Fri 120
2 green onions sliced; Rory only: chili crisp
steps: 5:00: toss the chicken with the salt and tamari. Whisk the glaze.
5:05: toast the cashews in a dry 12-in stainless skillet over medium 3 min until golden; out to a plate.
5:08: same pan, veg + 100 g broth, covered, high heat 4 min until bright green and crisp-tender; tip into a bowl.
5:13: wipe the pan, high heat 2 min, spray. Sear the chicken in 2 batches in one layer, 5–6 min per batch, turning once, until browned and 175°F; out to a plate.
5:27: glaze into the pan, boil 3–4 min, stirring, until it coats a spoon. Chicken and juices back in 1 min to coat; fold in the veg.
Rice: covered with 2 Tbsp broth, microwave 3 min to steaming.
Pack Wendy's Fri lunch first: 150 g chicken + 100 g veg + 120 g rice + 8 g cashews (fridge, eat Fri).
Rory: 180 g chicken in glaze, 10 g cashews, 150 g veg, 90 g rice ≈ 592 cal / 53 g P.

dinners.name: Steak night: seared grass-fed sirloin + chimichurri
dinners.desc: Rotation winner ('absolute banger'): hard-seared grass-fed top sirloin, low-oil chimichurri (red pepper flakes only in Rory's), oven-roasted Yukon potatoes at 425°F on two pans (oven, not air fryer), lemon-garlic green beans.
dinners.side: Oven-roasted Yukon potatoes + lemon-garlic green beans

ingredients: 1.5 lb (680 g) grass-fed top sirloin, ~1 in thick (frozen on delivery; fridge Wed night)
1 tsp kosher salt, ½ tsp pepper, ½ tsp garlic powder, avocado-oil spray

Chimichurri (~100 g): 30 g flat-leaf parsley chopped fine, 2 garlic cloves minced, ¾ tsp dried oregano, 20 g red wine vinegar, 10 g lemon juice, 18 g (4 tsp) extra-virgin olive oil, 20 g water, ⅓ tsp kosher salt, pinch of pepper. Rory's portion: + ¼ tsp red pepper flakes. Make Thu night or Fri; rest 15 min+.
Potatoes: 650 g Yukon Golds in 1-in chunks, split across 2 parchment-lined half-sheet pans, spray, ¾ tsp salt, ½ tsp garlic powder, ½ tsp smoked paprika (Rory 180 · Wendy 150 · Chloe 80 cooked)
Lemon-garlic green beans (~300 g cooked; Rory 150 · Wendy 100 · Chloe 50): 340 g green beans trimmed, 120 g bone broth, 3 garlic cloves sliced, zest of 1 lemon + 1 tsp juice, ⅓ tsp salt
steps: 4:45: salt the steaks; counter 30–40 min. Oven to 425°F.
5:00: potatoes in (both pans, upper-middle + lower-middle), 30–35 min, shaking at 15 and 25 min and swapping racks once, until deep golden.
5:20: green beans in a wide lidded pan with the broth and garlic: covered 6–7 min, then uncover and cook off the liquid 1–2 min; zest, juice, salt.

5:20: 12-in stainless skillet over medium-high 3 min, spray, sear the steaks 4–5 min per side to 130–135°F for medium-rare (USDA: 145°F; Chloe's piece to 145°F if she prefers). Rest 5–10 min, slice against the grain.
Spoon chimichurri over the sliced steak (Rory's from his spicy portion).
Rory: 170 g cooked sirloin, 180 g potatoes, 150 g green beans, 25 g chimichurri ≈ 584 cal / 59 g P.

prep.title: Delivery day
prep.step: FREEZE on arrival: salmon, sirloin, chicken thighs, nuggets. FRIDGE: chuck roast + chicken breasts (cooked Sunday). Maple Hill from Publix goes straight to the fridge.

prep.title: Salmon to the fridge
prep.step: Move the 1.25 lb salmon from the freezer to the fridge on a plate so it's thawed for Monday.

prep.title: Roast in first
prep.step: Oven to 325°F. Bloom the gelatin in 60 g of the measured broth. Season the chuck (no sear) into the pot with the apple, onion, garlic, ginger, honey, vinegar, tamari, broth, sesame oil, tomato paste and miso. Lid on; in the oven by 12:45. Done ~4:45.

prep.title: Bone broth rice (big batch)
prep.step: Rinse 800 g jasmine. Two 4-qt saucepans, each 400 g rice + 690 g bone broth + ½ tsp salt. Boil, cover, lowest heat 15 min, off heat 10 min → ~2,870 g. Spread on 2 sheet pans to cool (fridge within 1 hr).

prep.title: Lunch chicken (air fryer, 4 batches)
prep.step: Pound and season 6 lb air-chilled breasts lemon-oregano. Air-fry ~1½ lb per batch at 380°F 16–18 min, flipping halfway, to 165°F: batches at 1:00, 1:20, 1:40, 2:00. Rest each batch on a board.

prep.title: Creami bases (6 pints)
prep.step: Between air-fryer flips: blend and fill 2 honey vanilla, 1 chocolate PB, 1 cookies & cream, 1 pistachio, 1 mango. Lids on, freeze level. ~40 min.

prep.title: Aji verde + chermoula
prep.step: Blend the aji verde (220 g Maple Hill, 40 g cilantro, 20 g parmesan, 20 g lime, 1 garlic, 4 g salt); 6 cups × 40 g + a Tue jar of 70 g. Stir together Monday's chermoula (~100 g) in a small jar. Fridge both.

prep.title: Peas and carrots
prep.step: 3 bags frozen peas and carrots in 2 batches, covered with 45 g broth each, 6–7 min; season with salt, honey, lemon. Spread to cool.

prep.title: Chloe's Thursday jar
prep.step: Cook 45 g orzo 8–9 min; drain. Container: 5 frozen meatballs + 100 g orzo + 60 g marinara → FREEZER.

prep.title: Portion + label (scale out)
prep.step: FRIDGE: Rory boxes Mon/Tue/Wed (200 g chicken + 120 g rice + 150 g peas/carrots) · Wendy boxes Mon/Tue/Wed (150 + 120 + 100) · Tue chicken 370 g · Wendy Tue 120 g rice + 100 g peas/carrots · Chloe Tue 100 g rice + 40 g peas/carrots · Mon dinner rice 330 g · Wed dinner rice 330 g. FREEZER: Rory Thu + Fri boxes, Wendy Thu box, Thu dinner rice 380 g. Keep 340 g rice + 100 g for Chloe's Mon out for tonight. Label dish / day / grams / 'cooked 11/8'.

prep.title: Fruit + clean up
prep.step: Wash and cut fruit for bowls (kiwi, strawberries, blueberries); leave mangoes and apples whole. Clean up; everything put away by ~3:30. Break until 4:45.

prep.title: Roast out + shred
prep.step: Check it shreds easily (~200–205°F); if not, 20–30 min more. Shred into the juices; reduce on the stove 5–8 min if thin.

prep.title: Carrots + pack beef
prep.step: Honey-ginger carrots (covered 7–8 min with broth and ginger, then glaze with honey 3–4 min). Pack Wed beef 360 g + ½ cup juices and Chloe's Mon container (70 g beef + juices + 100 g rice), fridge.

prep.title: Dinner
prep.step: Rice warmed with 2 Tbsp broth; plate beef, rice, carrots. Creami third right after dinner.

prep.title: Thaw + to-do schedule
prep.step: Tue night: thighs → fridge (Thu). Wed night: Thu–Fri aji verde mini batch; Rory Thu box, Wendy Thu box, Thu rice, Chloe Thu jar and 1.5 lb sirloin → fridge. Thu night: Rory Fri box → fridge; chimichurri; pack Wendy's Fri lunch. Wed AM: nuggets straight from the freezer.

prepNote: Sun Nov 8: roast in by 12:45; rice, 6 lb lunch chicken, 6 Creami, sauces, peas and carrots and Chloe's Thursday jar 12:45–3:30 while it braises; dinner ~5:15. Back to 3 people, so the batch is smaller.

lunchIntro: Each morning: fill the 12 oz thermal jar with boiling water for 5–10 min, then dump it. Heat the hot food to 165°F (steaming), pack it into the warmed jar, and close it. Cold food goes in the steel bento with an ice pack, and everything goes in the insulated bag.
prepIntro: Times assume a 12:15 PM start and dinner around 5:15 PM. About 2¾ hours hands-on (the air fryer runs 4 chicken batches while you do Creami and sauces), then a break while the roast finishes. Tuesday is the car dinner (15 min), Wednesday is a 20-minute reheat, Saturday is the night out, and Mon/Thu/Fri dinners are cooked fresh (25–40 min).
prepSafety: Chicken 165°F (thighs best at 175°F); salmon 145°F; steak 130–135°F medium-rare (USDA 145°F); chuck shreds at ~200–205°F; reheated leftovers 165°F. Bell & Evans nuggets are sold uncooked: cook to 170°F.
Cool fast: spread rice on sheet pans; everything into the fridge within 1–2 hours (rice within 1 hour).
Fridge = eaten Mon–Wed. Freezer = Thu onward (Rory Thu/Fri boxes, Wendy Thu box, Thu rice, Chloe's Thu jar). Aji verde for Thu–Fri is blended fresh Wed night.
Reheat each portion only once. Label every container with dish, day, grams and 'cooked 11/8'.
prepThaw: Sat Nov 7 (delivery): freeze the salmon, sirloin, thighs and nuggets right away; chuck and breasts go in the fridge for Sunday.
Tue night: 1.75 lb thighs → fridge (for Thu).
Wed night: 1.5 lb sirloin → fridge (for Fri); Rory + Wendy Thu boxes, Thu rice, Chloe's Thu jar → fridge; blend the Thu–Fri aji verde.
Thu night: Rory's Fri box → fridge; make the chimichurri; pack Wendy's Fri lunch from dinner.
Saturday: night out, nothing to thaw.
